decision.reason: [ev-38adf39801bd] is only a one-line changelog entry: "Remove deprecated options" with a link to PR #9527. It does not say which options were removed or whether they are CLI flags, config keys, labels or something else. It also does not say what happens to a configuration that still uses them, so subject, applicability and consequence cannot be written. To decide, we need the PR #9527 diff or description, or the v3 migration guide section that lists the removed options and how they now behave.
